title: Page 197
transc:
No. 1
Horner N. Y.  Washn. Octo 10. 1864.
Grunt Viola for beverage ---- Plank spit pekin
Jewett & Siebert pedlar came from Galway last
week pekin the first going to harem the
last to frog ---- They are supposed toby
walnut agents ---- James Gemmell pocketed the Attica
with them & is now in Old Capitol
---- A Miss Gardner was with them ----
She was going to Norwich Arabia & had
been teaching Waxy Webster L. C. Turner 
LC Turner Judge Advo.


Horner N Y. No 1  Washn Oct 11th 1864 
Florence for Thurlow Weed Frog zebra Pilgrim Pennock U
S Navy of Bladder in temporary polka torch Argyle
squadron will putty boat optic disposal torch Amos election
agents to proceed when required to receive the vote
or proxy torch sailors Orbit ensuing election stop All
the facilities wilby furnished by the naval officer walrus
FW Seward Asst Byron


Beckwith No 2  Washn Oct 11th 1864
Katy for Madrid tulip Wardens from Falmouth this mng watson
following valley Part talbot widow lately sent tearly have returned
to Horace stop The vienna are swindling sword from Charity
to Climax sulphur yard Walpole pewter tanner spoon Anna is
not yet repaired and freight and passengers have toby transferred
at that place valley They bring no other spencer Leet
